text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She finished the Challenge Cup with a 
powerful run, having completely overcome 
her injury. It was as if you could already 
see the "marvelous" future she would 
seize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Riding this momentum, she would take on 
the Spring Senior Triple Crown next year. 
With her current form, she should be able 
to seize victory even in races packed with 
elite competitors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, Fuji Kiseki also praised 
her run. How much longer until "Marvelous" 
reaches Fuji Kiseki, one wonders...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...First up is the Osaka Hai. I've gained 
the momentum I need. The Senior Year to 
change everything will begin shortly.
